title: Wallenberg-NTU Presidential Postdoctoral Fellowship (2027 call)
about: NTU Singapore's Wallenberg-NTU Presidential Postdoctoral Fellowship 2027 call is open to researchers within five years of their PhD who can start by 31 December 2027. Applicants submit a research proposal; applications close 31 December 2026 (Singapore time), referee reports by 7 January 2027.
requirements: Within 5 years of obtaining PhD or equivalent degree
Available to take up the position no later than 31 December 2027
A thoughtful and realistic research proposal

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "A thoughtful and realistic research proposal" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"Independent research" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
